About Us

Nigeria's Premier Engineering Partner

Klassmec Technical Services Nigeria Limited is an indigenous engineering company with a proud heritage of excellence that began in November 1994 as Klassmec Enterprises. In 2002, we transitioned into a Limited Liability Company.

Over 30+ years, we've built a legacy of engineering precision, professional integrity, and customer satisfaction, serving as a trusted partner to organizations across Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, Real Estate, and Construction.

Why Choose Us

The Klassmec Edge: Our Competitive Advantage

Proven Industry Experience

Over two decades of successfully navigating the Nigerian engineering terrain gives us an unmatched advantage in project planning and execution.

Highly Skilled Professionals

Our team of certified engineers, project managers, and technicians undergo continuous training to stay at the cutting edge of industry best practices.

State-of-the-Art Facilities

Our well-equipped fabrication yard features modern machinery, allowing us to deliver precision and quality while controlling timelines.

Commitment to Standards

We operate in strict compliance with Nigerian (COREN, SON) and international engineering standards (API, ASME, AWS), ensuring reliability and safety.

Efficient Project Management

Our agile and lean project execution methodology minimizes waste, reduces costs, and ensures on-time project delivery.

End-to-End Solutions

From design to maintenance, our ability to handle all aspects of a project provides clients with a seamless, hassle-free experience.

Sectors

Industries We Serve

Our expertise spans key sectors of Nigeria's economy, delivering specialized solutions that meet each industry's unique demands.

Manufacturing

Plant maintenance, fabrication, and turnkey factory projects for manufacturers across Nigeria.

Oil & Gas

Storage tank fabrication, piping, and structural works for upstream and downstream operations.

Food & Beverage

Hygienic mechanical systems and facility construction for food and beverage producers.

Packaging

Machine installation, plant upgrades, and structural works for packaging facilities.

Real Estate & Construction

Full-scope civil, structural, and architectural works for residential and commercial projects.

Logistics & Warehousing

Warehouse construction, loading bays, and storage infrastructure for logistics companies.

Nonprofit & Development

Infrastructure solutions for NGOs and public health initiatives across West Africa.
